# The Personal Archive as Succession Infrastructure — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-80430
Voiceover: An accession-quality record preserves a house object beyond the founder’s lifetime while keeping the object, maker attribution, and museum stewardship distinct.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of James A. and Mary Elizabeth Kingsland, 1994

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CN04-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · CAPTURE — What cannot be reconstructed later?. Record why a choice was made, who contributed, what failed, what remains sensitive, and which relationship holds tacit knowledge. Use audio when voice carries nuance the file cannot.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CN04-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · PAIR — Can the physical and digital records find one another?. Pair garments, samples, notebooks, photographs, contracts, communications, and born-digital files through stable identifiers and relationship fields.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CN04-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · PRESERVE — Will the record open and remain trustworthy?. Maintain master and backup copies, record checksums and formats, document transformations, migrate deliberately, and keep known gaps visible.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CN04-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · AUTHORIZE — Who may act after absence?. Name stewards, alternates, access rules, privacy limits, conservation referrals, legal instruments, and a review process for loans, publication, licensing, interpretation, and disposal.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
